title: App runtime settings (platform.yaml) — DRAFT
description: Runtime settings the app developer controls. What the app is ALLOWED to have (network mode, databases, domains, auth roles, budget) is NOT here — that lives in the app definition apps/{slug}/app.yaml (app.schema.json) in the instance platform-config repo and changes only via portal request + approval (docs/adr/0008-gitops-config-repo-and-portal-workflow.md). Validated by `platform check` locally and in CI.

app.description: App slug as registered in the portal (ADR-0020): 3-20 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starts with a letter, ends with a letter or digit. Immutable. Must match the registration; the pipeline rejects a mismatch. Reserved-word checks run in `platform check` and the portal.

branches.description: Branch globs that deploy to nonprod on push. Default: all branches (last push wins). The default branch additionally creates a prod release request.

secrets.description: Secret NAMES in the app's own Key Vault. Never URLs, never values. Values are set per environment by the owner in the portal.

environments.description: Per-environment overrides of runtime settings, keyed by environment name (e.g. nonprod, prod).

secret.description: Must also be listed in top-level `secrets` (checked by `platform check`).

not.description: Reserved: injected by the platform or by Azure Container Apps (contract: docs/architecture/data-services.md#environment-variables-injected-by-the-platform).

port.description: Port the container listens on; also exported as $PORT.

size.description: Container size: xs = 0.25 vCPU / 0.5 GiB, s = 0.5 / 1, m = 1 / 2, l = 2 / 4. Larger sizes may need approval (instance policy).
